sharedRules.name: Prioritised Efficiency
sharedRules.description:
If your Army Faction is LEAGUES OF VOTANN, for the rest of the battle:
  -> At the start of the battle:
    -> Until the start of your next Command phase: all friendly LEAGUES OF VOTANN units gain the Hostile Acquisition ability (while the target is within range of an objective marker, the unit gets +1 to Hit rolls; you can re-roll the Charge roll; you can re-roll the Advance roll).
  -> At the end of each phase:
    During the Command phase:
      -> If you control 1+ home objectives in your territory, you gain 1 YP.
      From the second battle round onward:
        -> If you control 1+ objectives (excluding home), you gain 1 YP.
        -> If you control 2+ objectives (excluding home), you gain 1 YP.
        -> If you hold more objectives than the opponent, you gain 1 YP.
    During the Command phase, in your turn:
      -> While you have at most 6 yp pool, until the start of your next Command phase: all friendly LEAGUES OF VOTANN units gain the Hostile Acquisition (Prioritised Efficiency) ability.
    During the Command phase, in your turn:
      -> While you have 7+ yp pool, until the start of your next Command phase: all friendly LEAGUES OF VOTANN units gain the Fortify Takeover ability (while the unit is within range of an objective marker you control, the unit gets +1 to Hit rolls; when the attack's S is more than the target's T, unless the unit has the VEHICLE keyword, the attacking unit gets -1 to Wound rolls).

rules.description:

rules.name: Assailed From Every Angle
rules.description:
When the unit is selected to shoot during the Shooting phase, until the end of the battle round:
  -> Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTER or VEHICLE units): this unit must target that unit with ranged attacks.
  If the target was hit by an attack this phase:
    While the target is tagged assailed:
      -> Subtract 2 from the target's Move characteristic.
      -> The target gets -2 to Charge rolls.
    -> The target gains the assailed keyword.

rules.name: Ruthless Reinvestment
rules.description:
All friendly LEAGUES OF VOTANN units lose the Hostile Acquisition (Prioritised Efficiency) ability and cannot gain it except from this ability.
All friendly LEAGUES OF VOTANN units lose the Fortify Takeover (Prioritised Efficiency) ability and cannot gain it except from this ability.
-> At the start of the battle: all friendly LEAGUES OF VOTANN units gain the Hostile Acquisition (Prioritised Efficiency) ability.
-> At the end of your Command phase, you may use this ability: while you have 3+ yp pool, spend 3 YP; if all friendly LEAGUES OF VOTANN units have exactly one of the Hostile Acquisition (Prioritised Efficiency) and Fortify Takeover (Prioritised Efficiency) abilities, all friendly LEAGUES OF VOTANN units simultaneously lose that ability and gain the other.
